verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for a SaaS AI app builder, so the axis applies. Every documented capability is interactive and in-editor: chats, annotations, the draw tool and collaboration. No CLI, headless mode or CI integration is documented. A community report says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, forcing users to reverse-engineer the format, and probes found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
